{{Quote|You stand there because I allow it. Because I do not fear.|The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] taunts the Jedi before subduing them|<ref name="TOR:Descent" />}}
During the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Hero of Tython]] embarked on a mission with Jedi Masters [[Tol Braga]], [[Warren Sedoru]] and [[Leeha Narezz]]. The three were on a mission to infiltrate the [[Emperor's Fortress]] and defeat, capture and redeem the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Unfortunately for the [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]], the mission ended in absolute failure as the Sith Emperor easily defeated them, utterly crushed their wills and turned them into Sith.

==Prelude==
In [[3641 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] devised a plan to infiltrate the [[Emperor's Fortress]] to defeat, capture and redeem the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. His strike team, composed of [[Warren Sedoru]], [[Leeha Narezz]] and [[Jomar Chul]] gathered the critical components required to locate the Fortress, bypass the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and pierce the Fortress' [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] to board it, all separately aided by the [[Hero of Tython]]. But as they were devising their infiltration plan to dock at separate landing bays in the Fortress and converge on the throne room, they were interrupted by the rest of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], composed of [[Satele Shan]], [[Jaric Kaedan]] and [[Bela Kiwiiks]], accompanied by Chul. Kaedan was a strong opponent to Braga's plan, considering it reckless before revealing that Chul had informed him of a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] that Braga chose to ignore. Chul explained that while performing a [[healing meditation]] that he experienced a vision of the Hero falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and joining the Sith. Braga dismissed his vision, asserting that the future is always in motion, and further argued that the Council doesn't make judgements based on visions. Both Kiwiiks and Shan expressed their confidence in the Hero's loyalty and chose to side with Braga, prompting Chul to storm out of the Council Chambers in frustration, while Kaedan's final pleas failed to sway Braga from his course.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />

Using the maps of Imperial space that Chul had gathered, the Jedi strike team made their way to the Emperor's Fortress without issue and boarded the space station in separate docking bays which was cloaked by a powerful [[Cloaking device/Legends|Cloaking device]]. After the strike team checked in via holocall to the [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|Hero's ''Defender''-class light corvette]], [[Kira Carsen]], a member of the Hero's crew and a former [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]], announced that she could sense the Emperor waiting for them with a cold rage, leading her to suspect that it was a trap. However, the Hero remained confident of their success and disembarked, proceeding to work their way to the Emperor's throne room, cutting down those who got in their way.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Fight back! We can resist him!|[[Tol Braga]] before being subdued by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]|<ref name="TOR:Descent" />}}
The Hero of Tython arrived at the throne room first, and was met by [[Scourge (Sith)|Lord Scourge]], the [[Emperor's Wrath]]. Bluffing that the other members of the strike team were dead, Scourge dueled with the Hero, who ultimately prevailed but spared the Sith Lord's life. As Scourge strode to the Emperor's side, Masters Tol Braga, Leeha Narezz, and Warren Sedoru arrived at the throne room.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />

There, the Sith Emperor taunted the Jedi, saying they were puny, insignificant, and that he was not afraid of them. Unexpectedly, the Sith Emperor defeated the Jedi Strike Team with a mere wave of his hand, summoning a powerful storm of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The Emperor then corrupted the defeated Jedi and turned them into Sith.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />

==Aftermath==
{{GameLS}}
The Hero of Tython was placed under the supervision of Overseer [[Chaskar]], who oversaw the fallen Jedi's training. After an unknown amount of time, the Hero saw the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of their late master, [[Orgus Din]], during one such training session but shrugged it off, only to later fall unconscious. Din healed the Hero, who had retained no memory of what they had done under the Emperor's control. Din advised his former Padawan to conceal their true self from the Sith while trying to free their crew, vaguely promising a "dark ally" would help. The Jedi Knight was subsequently called by Chaskar to perform interrogation of a captive Kira Carsen. While readying to use the tormentor device, with Carsen, unaware that her Master had been redeemed, begged them to resist the Emperor, the Hero used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to get Chaskar to leave, allowing the Hero to free Carsen. Knowing the Imperials wouldn't be fooled for long, the two Jedi made their way back to the docking bay where their ship was, entering to find Lord Scourge having already free [[T7-O1]], [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] and Sergeant [[Fideltin Rusk]]. As the Jedi were skeptical of the Emperor's Wrath's intentions, Scourge revealed the reason why he did not kill the Hero on [[Quesh]] was because he had seen their face in a [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|vision]] over three hundred years ago. Bending the knee, Scourge declared his allegiance to the Jedi Knight, and requested to be brought before the Jedi Council on Tython. Doc and Carsen expressed skepticism over Scourge's motivations, but the Hero concluded that he must be the "dark ally" Din spoke of.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />

With Scourge's aid in navigating the defense grid, the Hero's party made a hasty retreat back to Tython. Meeting with the Jedi Council, the Hero informed them of the mission's failure and the absence of the other strike team members. When told of Scourge's actions, Kaedan firmly retorted that his motives were likely self-serving. Scourge responded that his change of allegiance was to stop a threat to himself and the Jedi, explaining that centuries ago, he had a vision of the Emperor destroying the galaxy, but the Hero of Tython would be the one to thwart him. He further explained that the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] was merely a diversion to conceal the Emperor's true plan, repeat a ritual he enacted on [[nathema|world he once ruled]] a thousand years ago to consume life on all planets. His first target would be the the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where billions of simultaneous deaths would begin the ritual. Kaedan objected to involving Scourge in their plans to the point of a lightsaber. Even as Scourge argued that the Emperor's agents were targeting other worlds for the ritual, but both the Hero and Shan could both sense he spoke the truth. The Hero then set off for Belsavis.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
This duel represents the finale of Act II for the Jedi Knight Story.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />

The player has three choices when dealing with Chaskar:
# Using a mind trick for light side points.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />
# Bluff that the tormentor wasn't functioning.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />
# Dispense with the deception and cut him down.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />
